name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2071: Reel directories exist because of a fold that runs at SEAL time, so a session that dies before it seals leaves its frames loose forever - invisible to every lane and every deleter by construction. On his tree that is 2385 frames, 3.15 GB, a fifty-one minute recording from 01:15 to 02:06 that no sweep could reach. orphan_fold.py clusters them and folds each into its own reel. THE REFUSAL IS THE LOAD-BEARING HALF: ensure_reel_index derives sessionId from the directory name minus reel_, PROVEN in the guard, so folding leftovers of an already-sealed session under a new name would mint a second session id for ONE recording and forge exactly the independence the keep and throw bars demand. Any cluster whose window overlaps an existing reel is reported and never moved, and the name is reel_s_t0_n so v2065s recording parser still reads it. It moves, never deletes, and refuses without --yes.
